AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
The Traffic Safety Committee, at the direction of the Chair with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Traffic Safety Committee meetings.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
